# The Black-Bile Congregation — Draft Datasheets

*Owned verb: **CORRODE** · generated by `unit_calculator.py faction` · ×1.5 scale · stat line = MOV · MS · RS · ARM · MIGHT · CTRL*

**Core trait — Aura of Rust & Rot · Bloated Resilience:** Enemy units within Contagion Range of any Black-Bile unit have −1 ARM (not cumulative). Contagion Range: 3″ in Round 1, 6″ in Round 2, 9″ from Round 3. Black-Bile units (except [EXPENDABLE] ones) have UNYIELDING 5+.

**Gamble — Rupture the Blight-Sacs** *(risk: durability (permanent))*: When a unit activates: each enemy unit within 3″ suffers D3 Fatal Wounds on a 4+. That Black-Bile unit loses UNYIELDING for the rest of the battle.

**Army-wide rules (priced into every unit):** *Aura of Rust & Rot* — Enemies nearby −1 ARM (≈ +1 PEN while in range). · *Bloated Resilience* — UNYIELDING 5+.

## Detachment — Infected Ground

*Take objectives, rot them, walk on.*

**Detachment rule:** Corrupted Objectives: objectives you control are [SECURED] and emit a 3″ Contagion aura (−1 ARM) until an enemy controls them.

**Enhancements**
- **Censer of Rot** (+30 pts, Lord of Black Bile): The attached unit has UNYIELDING 5+ even if ruptured.
- **Pox-Banner** (+10 pts, Blight-Knights): +1 CTRL per model.

**Stratagems**
- **Fester** (1 CP) — *End of Round:* An enemy unit within 3″ of a corrupted objective suffers D3 Fatal Wounds on a 4+.
- **Rot from Within** (1 CP) — *An enemy unit takes an objective you corrupted:* It is Rattled.
- **Seep** (1 CP) — *Command Phase:* Contagion Range is +3″ this round (max 9″).

## Detachment — Death-Blister Brotherhood

*Melee hordes that punish anything that fights them.*

**Detachment rule:** Spreaders of Filth: every Black-Bile model destroyed in melee inflicts 1 Fatal Wound on the attacking unit on a 5+.

**Enhancements**
- **Blister-Mantle** (+25 pts, Rot-Herald Champion): UNYIELDING 5+.
- **Plague-Bell** (+20 pts, Pox-Physician): Friendly Class 1 units within 6″ get +1 Attack in melee on a round they charged.

**Stratagems**
- **Burst Open** (1 CP) — *A unit is destroyed in melee:* Every enemy unit within 3″ suffers D3 Fatal Wounds on a 4+.
- **Shambling Tide** (1 CP) — *A Class 1 unit declares a Charge:* +2″ to the roll.
- **Endless Pox** (2 CP) — *Command Phase, once per battle:* Return a destroyed Pox-Carriers unit at half strength within 6″ of your table edge.

## Detachment — Smog Engines

*Daemon-engines and drones behind a curtain of filth.*

**Detachment rule:** Smog and Smoke: friendly Class 1–2 units within 9″ of a Black-Bile Class 3–5 unit are [STEALTH] against attacks from more than 12″.

**Enhancements**
- **Daemon-Furnace** (+10 pts, Blight-Furnace Bell-Tank): Corrupting Smog range 9″.
- **Rot-Crew** (+55 pts, Necrotic Siege-Crawler): UNYIELDING improves by 1 (5+).

**Stratagems**
- **Choking Clouds** (1 CP) — *An enemy unit within 9″ of a Class 3–5 unit Shoots:* −1 to Hit.
- **Grinding Advance** (1 CP) — *A Class 3–5 unit activates:* +2″ MOV.
- **Rusted Ram** (1 CP) — *A Class 4 unit ends a Charge:* Crushing Impact for 0 CP.
